name: Perplexity
tagline: AI-powered search engine with citations, deep research, and conversational follow-ups
verdictSummary: You can build a UI that sends queries to an LLM with a web search API (Brave, SerpAPI) and displays results with citations. That takes an afternoon. But Perplexity's real engineering is the retrieval-augmented generation pipeline — crawling, indexing, chunking, reranking, and the query reformulation that produces those crisp accurate answers. The RAG infrastructure is a full-time engineering team's work.
coreLoopDIY: Search UI with LLM-powered answer generation and source citations
whatYouLose: Proprietary web-scale crawling and indexing infrastructure
moatNotes: The search index and RAG pipeline at scale is the real product — not the chat interface that wraps it
whyPeopleStillPay: Faster, more accurate answers than Google because Perplexity's pipeline synthesizes across multiple sources with citations
notes: A weekend project gives you a search+LLM wrapper. Production-quality search infrastructure is a different league.
